turns.assessment: The fault is localized to the receiving line interface trx.och174.z. Its pre-FEC BER worsened immediately after OTU_LOF, while received power, OSNR, DGD, SOP rate, channel monitors, and every amplifier metric remained stable. That pattern strongly favors receiver-local degradation over a line, amplifier, transmitter, or power-related fault; a channel-specific WSS filter shift is the main residual alternative because it can impair quality without changing power.

proposals.rationale: OTU_LOF and increased pre-FEC BER occur at this receiver only, with normal optical power and path telemetry. Earlier errored seconds also suggest receiver-local impairment. A card failure is inconsistent with the interface continuing to provide monitoring.
A channel-specific shifted or narrowed WSS passband could degrade BER and framing while leaving measured channel power normal, although there is no direct spectral evidence identifying such a WSS.
This transmitter feeds the affected receiver, but a laser failure should produce a received-power or signal-loss indication, which was not observed.
A receiver card failure could interrupt traffic locally, but the documented mode should make monitoring silent and mask traffic alarms; instead, a BER change was reported.
